title: Nuevas industrias
goal: Read how governments moved from protecting private industry with tariffs to directly building state-owned steel mills, hydroelectric plants, and eventually automobile assembly across the region.
grammar: Por parte de: atribuir la acción en construcciones formales

items: State what Brazil's government inaugurated in 1941.
Explain the new economic role many governments took on.
Name the industries that developed over the following two decades.
Describe what Brazil, Mexico and Argentina's industrial sectors looked like by the mid-1960s.
Use por parte de to attribute an action to an agent in formal writing.
